draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.50, the 9th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 1st of 28 at WR. He went 10th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (81st percentile), 10-yard split (88th percentile). Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (20th percentile). College production: 1,058 receiving yards in 2021, 13th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 58 career games and 53 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 10 in 2024. Weak spots: yards after catch per reception 2.8 (12th percentile), yards per target 6.7 (20th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 wide receiver who played: 395 receiving yards against a median of 302, above the norm.
